question: Medical treatment with intranasal corticosteroids can correct an anatomically deviated nasal septum and is the first-line treatment for symptomatic DNS.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct to mark this false. No medical therapy corrects a structural deviation. Nasal steroids may provide temporary symptomatic relief by reducing mucosal swelling, but septoplasty is the definitive intervention for symptomatic DNS.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This statement is actually false. Intranasal corticosteroids reduce mucosal oedema and can improve airflow, but they cannot alter bone or cartilage anatomy. Septoplasty is the only definitive treatment for symptomatic anatomical DNS.
